meta.title: Vietnam E-Visa for Indians 🇻🇳 | How to Apply Online Step by Step
meta.description:
Planning a trip to Vietnam? 🇻🇳 In this video, I show you how to apply for a Vietnam E-Visa online, step by step.

I’ll walk you through the online application process and explain the important things you need to know before submitting your application.

📌 In this video:

* Vietnam E-Visa application process
* Documents required
* Passport requirements
* Photo requirements & size
* Application form filling
* Visa fee & payment process
* How to check application status
* Common mistakes to avoid
* Step-by-step online application

This video is especially useful for Indian travellers planning a trip to Vietnam.

⚠️ Visa rules, fees and processing requirements can change, so always verify the latest information on Vietnam’s official immigration website before applying.

If this video helps you, LIKE 👍 | SHARE ↗️ | SUBSCRIBE ❤️
